title: Senior Software Engineer (Lending)
description:
About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of decisioning engine features and rules, being able to explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate on lending decisioning context, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Credit, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Advanced English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Plus: previous experience with loan origination systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.

  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Revenue Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our sales strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities.   • Partner with Sales and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy —including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.

  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, sales cycles, and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field .

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth .
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture .
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.

O coordenador será responsável por estruturar, documentar, sustentar e evoluir os processos da área, além de desenvolver a equipe tecnicamente e operacionalizar controles de qualidade, métricas e melhoria contínua.

O foco central do cargo é transformar diretrizes de IAM/IGA em operações eficientes, seguras e auditáveis, com base em boas práticas e frameworks reconhecidos (NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Zero Trust Architecture, Microsoft Identity Security Framework, IGA Market Guides e CIS Controls).

Liderança Estratégica

  • Traduzir objetivos de negócio em estratégias claras de identidade e acesso;
  • Atuar junto à diretoria, GRC, engenharia de segurança e arquitetura para alinhar entregas de IGA;
  • Consolidar a visão de IAM como função crítica para segurança e conformidade.

Governança e Processos

  • Estruturar e documentar processos (RACI, fluxogramas, SOPs);
  • Implementar controles operacionais de qualidade, com indicadores de eficiência e maturidade;
  • Garantir aderência a auditorias, regulações (LGPD, SOX, ISO) e políticas internas.

Excelência Operacional e Entrega de Valor

  • Gerenciar projetos e operações recorrentes da equipe de IAM, assegurando previsibilidade e acurácia;
  • Definir e acompanhar OKRs, SLAs e KPIs da área;
  • Sustentar operações modernas de:
    • Governança de acesso (recertificações, SoD, RBAC, JIT/JEA);
    • Administração segura de AD e Entra ID (Tiering, PAW, Break-Glass, PIM);
    • Integração com SIEM, UEBA e MITDR em parceria com outras áreas.

Desenvolvimento de Equipe

  • Conduzir mentorias técnicas e comportamentais;
  • Definir trilhas de capacitação e evolução individual;
  • Promover cultura de autonomia, responsabilidade e aprendizado contínuo.

Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Active Directory: arquitetura segura, GPOs, trusts, replication, hardening (CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Baselines);
  • Domínio de Azure Entra ID e Entra ID Governance, incluindo integração com ambientes on-premises;
  • Experiência em arquitetura de IAM/IGA, com visão estratégica e orientação a resultados;
  • Vivência na liderança de equipes técnicas em segurança da informação.

Sobre o Wellz

Em 2021, o Wellhub fundou o Wellz com o objetivo de democratizar a saúde mental no Brasil. Possibilitamos que empresas ajudem suas equipes a serem mais saudáveis, mais resilientes e mais engajadas. Através da nossa plataforma, é possível realizar atendimento clínico individual online, acessar conteúdos interativos sobre saúde mental e participar de rodas de conversa em grupo. Facilitamos o acesso das pessoas a uma jornada de autocuidado e autoconhecimento que seja ideal para as suas necessidades individuais. A abordagem que utilizamos é a Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental, com intervenções voltadas para a melhora clínica individual e baseadas em evidências.

A oportunidade

O Wellz está crescendo e, por isso, estamos procurando psicólogos e psicólogas com experiência clínica para fazer parte da nossa comunidade. Você receberá pacientes, realizará sessões de psicoterapia, terá acesso a supervisão gratuita e fará parte de uma inovadora solução de cuidado à saúde mental.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia;
  • Especialização ou pós-graduação completa em Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental;
  • Experiência prévia realizando psicoterapia online individual;
  • Inscrição ativa no Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP);
  • Habilidades para conduzir atendimentos de forma online;
  • Possuir computador para realização de atendimento clínico, assim como outros equipamentos que garantam a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Ter empresa aberta, cuja atividade seja compatível com serviços psicológicos.

Por que fazer parte do time de parceiros do Wellz?

  • Nova fonte de renda, sem custo extra para se juntar à nossa rede;
  • Acesso a novos pacientes, trazidos diretamente até você;
  • Flexibilidade de horário, com a possibilidade de criar a sua própria agenda;
  • Metodologia comprovada, baseada em dados e tecnologia;
  • Comunidade de terapeutas para dividir aprendizados e melhores práticas;
  • Supervisão clínica sem custo e com orientação direcionada;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para cuidar da sua saúde de forma integral.

Compromisso com a inclusão

O Wellz é para todas as pessoas, independente da religião, orientação sexual, etnia, gênero e outros. Se você preenche os requisitos necessários, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte dessa rede que só cresce!

Responsável pela negociação e implementação das estratégias de trade junto aos clientes de off premise, atuando como gestor da equipe de promotores, supervisionando e desenvolvendo esses profissionais para executar com sucesso as nossas marcas no mercado, visando maximizar os negócios dos clientes e da Heineken Brasil.

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país. Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena. Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades. O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a Vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável por atuar na administração de registros e documentos escolares. Terá a função de operacionalizar os processos de matrícula e transferência, de organização de turmas e de registros do histórico escolar dos estudantes.

Responsabilidades

  • Organizar e manter em dia o protocolo, o arquivo escolar e o registro de assentamento dos alunos, bem como a regularidade da vida escolar do aluno;
  • Verificar a autenticidade dos documentos escolares;
  • Organizar e manter em dia a coletânea de leis, regulamentos, diretrizes, portarias, circulares, resoluções e demais documentos;
  • Redigir a correspondência que lhe for confiada, lavrar atas e termos, nos livros próprios;
  • Rever todo o expediente a ser submetido ao despacho da Direção;
  • Apresentar à Direção, em tempo hábil, todos os documentos que devem ser assinados;
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos bens materiais distribuídos à Secretaria;
  • Manter sigilo sobre assuntos pertinentes ao serviço;
  • Responder ao Censo Escolar Anual.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Requisitos

  • Diploma de curso técnico em secretaria escolar ou Licenciatura Plena em Pedagogia;

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences; to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors; partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner; reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity; cares holistically for those served; maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered; treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.

Minimum Requirements

  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.

  • Work within AWS/Linux cloud systems environment in support of data integration solution
  • Works closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with team members. Share knowledge, provide visibility of interpersonal accomplishments and follow directions when provided.

Company Benefits

  • Flexible working hours

  • Continuing education, training, conferences

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

title: Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description:
Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to join the Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division of Crude Oil Sales & Marketing Dept (COSMD).

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and manage various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and long-term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consult directly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management.
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis to support the areas of commercializing low carbon crude oil and low carbon products such as LCAF, SAF, Naphtha and others with focus on offsetting and carbon markets mechanisms.
  • Prepare and present plans, analyses, interpretations, conclusions and recommendations to Management and others on a broad range of petroleum market issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognized and approved program.
  • Advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.
  • Over 12 years of experience in oil and gas sustainability, Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) and carbon market industry.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets and environmental regulations related to GHG Emissions with understanding of the compliance carbon markets, voluntary carbon markets, baseline and crediting mechanisms, carbon-related trade measures and carbon pricing.
  • Extensive knowledge of global crude oil market balances and flows; pricing dynamics and structures; and methodologies of reporting agencies and exchange contracts.
  • Familiarity with refinery and petrochemicals, linear programming, and investment financial modeling is preferred.
  • Understanding of refining and refining economics.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from qualified candidates.

title: Commission Analyst
description:
Overview

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Commissions Analyst to ensure accuracy, responsiveness, and scalability in how commissions and revenue operations are managed in a dynamic, high-growth environment with multiple commission plans, frequent changes, and evolving billing needs.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient processes that reduce risk and improve visibility. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver timely and accurate commissions, resolve system issues, and implement process improvements that scale with the business. This role is critical to ensuring commissions are paid correctly and on time, while also strengthening revenue recognition and reporting processes.

Responsibilities

  • Accurate and reliable commissions: Ensure commission processes are managed with precision, supporting timely and error-free payouts that build trust across the sales organization.
  • Clear visibility into revenue operations: Strengthen reporting and data integrity in Spiff, Salesforce, and billing systems, enabling leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.
  • Proactive issue resolution: Help surface and address discrepancies in opportunities, contracts, or commission data early, minimizing downstream risks and delays.
  • Scalable processes and automation: Contribute to the design of workflows and reporting that reduce manual effort, improve transparency, and adapt as the business grows.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Build strong relationships with Sales, Finance, and Operations by serving as a reliable partner and trusted resource on commissions and revenue reporting.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, commissions administration, or related finance roles, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment.
  • Strong technical proficiency with commissions tools (Spiff preferred), Salesforce CRM, and billing/AR platforms, with the ability to implement changes and troubleshoot independently.
  • Background in accounting operations (billing, invoicing, AR, or contract review) that strengthens commission accuracy and revenue reporting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent projects without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in reconciliations, variance analysis, and supporting ASC 340-40 compliance.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who provides fast, reliable support to cross-functional stakeholders.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full-time employees. TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work-life balance, we encourage you to ask about balance within teams and reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.

The Stakes Are Real: Our work has direct, real-world impact, including supporting urgent government requests, terrorist financing investigations, and global security efforts. We also build new processes quickly to stop criminals before they cash out and analyze blockchain data to recover stolen savings.

Life at TRM

As a remote-first company, TRM is built for global collaboration. We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication and meaningful relationships, invest in offsites and onboarding buddies, and prioritize trust and belonging.

Join our mission. We\'re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. If you’re excited about TRM\'s mission, we want to hear from you. TRM is remote-first, with a globally distributed team.

description:
Join to apply for the Business Analyst role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About The Role

We are hiring a Business Analyst to strengthen our Client Services team by owning reporting, reconciliation, and proactive analysis across client accounts. This role ensures accuracy in case counts and budgets, surfaces performance insights, and creates scalable reporting solutions that empower the entire team.

The ideal candidate is mid-level, highly analytical, and able to take full ownership of results with minimal oversight. They are adept at spotting trends, building actionable reports, and anticipating issues before they become problems. Over time, this role may evolve into a companywide business analyst position, with broader responsibility for insights and reporting across teams.

Location: Remote (must be available 9am - 5p ET)

What You'll Do

Client Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Case Data Reconciliation: Own the process of reconciling signed case counts between internal systems and client reports, resolving discrepancies independently.
  • Fund Reallocations: Accurately process client requests to move budgets across projects, ensuring all updates are reflected in reporting.
  • Custom Reporting: Deliver accurate, client-ready reports that align with goals and expectations, while continuously improving report templates and workflows.

Proactive Analysis & Insights

  • Issue Detection: Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and profitability by lead type and field values to proactively spot risks and opportunities.
  • Performance Analysis: Provide insights into client and campaign profitability, pricing effectiveness, and lead monetization trends.
  • Self-Serve Reporting: Build dashboards and recurring reports that give team members visibility into critical KPIs without requiring manual analysis each time.
  • Scalable Insights: Develop frameworks for analyzing trends that can be reused across clients and campaigns.

Operational Excellence & Financial Control

  • Accuracy Safeguarding: Ensure all reconciliations, reallocations, and reports are error-free and backed by clear data sources.
  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in reporting and reconciliation, and create scalable solutions that save time and reduce errors.
  • Collaboration: Support the Director of Client Services by taking on data-heavy work, freeing leadership to focus on strategy and client growth.

Client-Facing Support

  • Email Communication: Participate in client email threads to share reconciled numbers, reporting deliverables, and updates related to reallocations.
  • Light Client Interaction: Join occasional client calls to clarify data, while leaving strategic discussions to the Director of Client Services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in business analysis, reporting, client operations, or related analytical roles. Experience in legal case acquisition or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Master level of proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas) and reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to slice/dice data, reconcile discrepancies, and extract actionable insights across multiple variables (lead type, conversion rates, profitability, etc.).
  • Automation & Tools: Comfortable building repeatable reports, dashboards, and using AI or automation to accelerate data comparison and analysis.
  • Ownership: Able to take responsibility for results with little oversight, quickly becoming the go-to person for reporting and analysis.
  • Communication: Clear, concise written skills for client-facing updates and internal reports.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn new systems quickly and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift rapidly.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Extremely detail-oriented and accuracy-obsessed.
    • High ownership, proactive problem-solver who identifies issues before others see them.
    • Curious and driven to dig into data until key insights emerge.
    • Comfortable in a support role, enabling leadership to focus on higher-level strategy.
    • Growth-oriented, eager to expand from client-level reporting into companywide business analysis.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
    • medical (Aetna)
    • dental (Guardian)
    • vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
  • 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation.

title: Developer Relations (Americas)
description:
Overview

Runware is building a leading API for all AI. Our platform makes it easy for developers to add advanced media generation capabilities to their products in hours instead of months, without the burden of managing GPUs, scaling, or constant model updates. By combining custom hardware with optimized software and orchestration, we deliver unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across hundreds of thousands of models. Backed by top global investors, we're growing quickly and building a team to shape the future of AI development.

About The Role
We\'re looking for Developer Relations to be the technical voice connecting our media generation API with the developer community. You\'ll bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developers building on Runware—from indie creators to enterprise teams integrating our generation capabilities into their products.

First and foremost, you must be passionate about generative AI and able to demonstrate it through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, or other hands-on work. We\'re looking for builders with some development experience. You don\'t need to be a superstar engineer, but you should be comfortable writing and debugging code.

This is an intentionally broad role that will flex around your strengths. It could include creating educational content, debugging integrations, supporting developers, building SDKs and integrations, or representing Runware at events and hackathons. You might maintain SDKs or third-party integrations, build new integrations, or contribute workflow examples and tutorials. A key part of the role is bringing value to our ecosystem which could include being active in public — sharing your work, engaging with other developers, and making technical content visible across socials, forums, and communities. You\'ll help Runware have a strong presence where developers already are.

More than just a job title, this is an invitation to join a company that\'s spearheading the future of AI. We\'re looking for people who want to partner with us, explore their passion for AI, and help other developers succeed. Your technical credibility with developers matters most. Everything else is flexible.

Is this role a fit for you?

If you\'re unsure whether you tick every box below but you\'re excited by AI and have something to show, we\'d love to hear from you. This role is designed to flex around the right people. If you\'ve built projects, contributed to communities, or simply can\'t stop experimenting with generative AI, you already have what matters most. We are even open to freelancers who may just want to contribute in one specific area. Apply and let\'s explore how your passion can grow with Runware.

What This Role Could Entail

  • Write and share technical content — blog posts, guides, videos, and walkthroughs — and distribute it across socials, forums, and developer communities
  • Actively manage and grow our developer community across Discord, Reddit, and social platforms, including hosting office hours, AMAs, workshops, and spotlighting community projects
  • Represent Runware at conferences, hackathons, and developer events, and support inbound interest by helping developers go from first experiment to production usage
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for developers using our API across community channels such as Discord, GitHub, and forums, while surfacing documentation gaps and collaborating with the team to improve clarity
  • Maintain and build our SDKs, plugins, and third-party integrations like ComfyUI or Vercel, and create sample projects, code examples, and workflow tutorials

Requirements

  • First and foremost: you are extremely passionate about AI, particularly generative AI or media generation, and can demonstrate this through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, hackathons, or other hands-on work
  • Some development experience. Comfortable working with schemas, APIs, and full-stack concepts (backend and frontend). The exact languages or frameworks you\'ve used matter less than your ability to build and explain working solutions
  • Experience experimenting with AI technologies such as training LoRAs, building advanced workflows in ComfyUI, or integrating AI models into projects
  • A blend of coding ability and AI know-how. You can navigate developer tooling and generative AI workflows, even if you\'re not a senior specialist in either
  • Excellent technical writing skills. Able to explain complex concepts clearly for developers, and actively share that content across forums, socials, and developer communities
  • Active in developer ecosystems from AI/ML Discord servers and GitHub to hackathons, meetups, or developer events. Comfortable representing and amplifying technical work in public

Benefits

We\'re a remote-first team that comes together in person twice a year to plan, collaborate, and celebrate wins. Day to day we keep a few core hours for teamwork, but outside of that you set the schedule that helps you do your best work.

Our environment is fast-moving and ambitious. Big pushes are part of building category-defining products, but we balance that with flexible working, generous time off, and regular retreats so the team can stay sharp and motivated.

  • Generous paid time off - vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options - share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup - work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours - own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave - paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats - twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT . The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note , due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process , shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusion and diversity. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

title: Revit BIM Specialist - Parametric Family Development
description:
Revit BIM Specialist - Parametric Family Development

We are seeking a Revit expert to support the development of a parametric Revit RFA (Revit Family) library for a leading manufacturer of stainless steel foodservice equipment. The project involves creating intelligent and efficient Revit families aligned with manufacturing standards and industry best practices, for eventual upload to a third-party BIM content hosting platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Create advanced Revit RFA families for foodservice equipment that are fully parametric and adaptable to user inputs.
  • Develop and link .TXT catalog files to drive type variations from a single RFA file.
  • Follow FCSI Revit Foodservice Equipment Standards in naming, categorization, and family structure.
  • Implement dynamic constraints (e.g., automatically adding legs based on length changes) based on manufacturing logic.
  • Deliver three fully completed RFA + .TXT samples for review before full project rollout.
  • Ensure all deliverables are in Revit 2021 format and ready for upload to a hosting platform.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to address feedback and iterate on content as needed.

Requirements:

  • Demonstrated experience building complex, parametric Revit families.
  • Strong understanding of BIM standards, particularly FCSI or other industry-specific guidelines.
  • Proficiency with Revit (2021 or newer) and use of external catalog files (.TXT).
  • Ability to interpret technical product data and apply it to Revit parametrics.
  • Focus on clean modeling practices and ease of use for end-users.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently with defined milestones.
  • Fluent in English and advanced communication skills.
  • Previous experience working for the U.S Market preferred.

Benefits:

  • Work for the most exciting companies in the North American Market.
  • Flexible schedules.
  • Work from anywhere.
  • Highly competitive compensation.

This is an equal opportunities employer.

description:
Sobre a Avenue
Na Avenue, somos movidos por um propósito claro: expandir o potencial do investidor brasileiro, fazendo sua vida render mais — em dólar. Isso significa oferecer acesso a oportunidades globais de investimento, com produtos, serviços e experiências que ajudam nossos clientes a construir um futuro financeiro mais sólido, diversificado e conectado ao mundo.

Sobre a vaga
Buscamos alguém com visão crítica, capacidade de execução e vontade de construir soluções robustas e escaláveis. Valorizamos quem se envolve com o problema, contribui com o time e busca entregar com qualidade e propósito. Se você gosta de atuar em squads multidisciplinares, com autonomia e responsabilidade, essa vaga é pra você.

No seu dia a dia, você terá como responsabilidade

  • Automatizar o provisionamento, a implantação e a escalabilidade da infraestrutura de software utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Auxiliar as equipes de desenvolvimento no provisionamento e sustentação de ambientes, garantindo alta disponibilidade e resiliência;
  • Suportar e aprimorar o ambiente de CI/CD, incluindo práticas de DevSecOps e automação de testes de confiabilidade;
  • Suportar e aprimorar os sistemas de monitoramento, logging e tracing, definindo e acompanhando SLIs, SLOs e SLAs;
  • Automatizar rotinas de infraestrutura e resposta a incidentes, reduzindo MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery);
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para garantir eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade contínua;
  • Desenvolver e manter documentações técnicas detalhadas, incluindo runbooks e playbooks de incidentes;
  • Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor financeiro, sem comprometer a performance e a disponibilidade dos serviços;
  • Participar de post-mortems e propor melhorias contínuas para evitar recorrência de falhas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na área;
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Kubernetes (incluindo práticas de resiliência e auto-healing), Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem como Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento como Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog e práticas de observabilidade;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Git e GitOps, como GitHub, ArgoCD ou similares;
  • Experiência com automação de infraestrutura e configuração de sistemas;
  • Habilidade para solucionar problemas complexos, analisar incidentes e propor melhorias estruturais;
  • Experiência com linguagens de script como Python, Bash ou PowerShell;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis como Kanban e Scrum;
  • Vivência com cultura de confiabilidade (SRE mindset).

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento/certificação em DataDog ou outras ferramentas de observabilidade;
  • Certificação Kubernetes Certified Administrator (CKA) ou Kubernetes Certified Application Developer (CKAD);
  • Certificação Terraform;
  • Certificação em um dos provedores de nuvem:
    • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Experiência em implantação de Internal Developer Portal;
  • Experiência em Chaos Engineering ou práticas de resiliência;
  • Vivência com FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.

Informações adicionais
Essa é uma vaga 100% home office para regime CLT.

Benefícios

  • Vale refeição e vale alimentação atrativos;
  • Plano de Saúde Omint;
  • Plano Odontológico Amil;
  • Seguro de vida MetLife;
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass;
  • Auxílio home office no valor de R$200 reais mensais;
  • Home office boost: incentivo único no valor de R$2.000 depositado assim que você entrar na Avenue para que ajude a dar um upgrade no seu set up;
  • Incentivo educacional (reembolso para cursos, certificações e eventos);

  • Auxílio Creche no valor de R$455 para cada filho(a) de até 5 anos;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Overview

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team. As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We\'re looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team and take ownership of building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, can work independently, and enjoys collaborating across teams to deliver reliable solutions. You will be the primary data engineer, working closely with leadership, DevOps, research, and customer support to ensure that data flows are efficient, secure, and optimized for business needs.

You will have the opportunity to design, implement, and maintain systems that directly impact company operations, from ETL processes to data modeling and analytics readiness. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a startup-style environment. If you are passionate about data engineering, comfortable collaborating across time zones, and eager to take ownership of impactful solutions, this position offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution and grow within a high-performing team.

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or similar roles.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Apache Airflow (MWAA a big plus).
  • Experience with Snowflake.
  • Strong SQL skills.

  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

title: Interim Executive Director
description:
Join to apply for the Interim Executive Director role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Founding Director, the purpose of this position is to provide day-to-day leadership for all Center for Journalism & Democracy (CJD) staff while a permanent Executive Director search is conducted. The interim Executive Director will be responsible for implementation and oversight of Center programs at Howard and at its campus partners at various HBCUs. The interim Executive Director will be responsible for operationalizing the vision of the Founding Director, supervising Center staff and its day-to-day operation, and provide guidance to all members of the team. This position will help the Center fulfill its mission: To bolster the field of journalism in service of our multiracial democracy by supporting the teaching and practice of historically informed investigative reporting at Howard University and across the constellation of historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs). The Center provides academic and financial support to students, faculty and news organizations located at Howard University and the nation’s largest journalism programs located at HBCUs.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for multiple functions within a department. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Typically, responsible for performing some non-supervisory duties in addition to supervisory responsibilities. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large. External contacts include alumni, consultants, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide strategic, holistic, high-level oversight and direction for the Center
  • Works closely with the Chief of Staff and Business Manager to manage grant spending and tracking for the CJD’s multi-million dollar grant portfolio
  • Works closely with the Chief of Staff, Business Manager and Development Manager to supervise the development and monitoring of grant proposal budgets and grant reports, ensuring alignment with the University advancement team and relevant grant accounting offices.
  • Creates, in collaboration with division heads, budgets for programming
  • Lead Center staff and directors in developing and implementing programs and ensure alignment across the Center’s strategic pillars
  • Identify and execute strategic partnerships within and outside of the university
  • Develop and execute fundraising campaigns in partnership with the Development Manager
  • Serve as spokesperson to represent the Center externally in public, professional, and community activities
  • Foster an inclusive and productive team culture
  • Create a space for professional development of team members
  • Ensure that the work of the Center is aligned with the Founding Director’s vision and proceeds in a timely and fiscally responsible manner
  • Set clear, measurable goals to direct the Center’s ongoing work and develop systems to evaluate progress towards those goals
  • Lead the development and launch of new projects as appropriate for the Center.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • At least 10 years of experience leading and managing a team of 10+ individuals.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and bring together a team in pursuit of common, measurable goals
  • Familiarity with journalism and investigative reporting; journalism experience preferred.
  • Proven success in managing multiple, complex, high-profile projects.
  • Demonstrated success performing and leading in a high growth/startup environment.
  • Fundraising experience
  • Experience developing systems and processes in support of implementing a high-level vision.
  • Comfort with developing and managing budgets, including management of intake and use of philanthropic funds.
  • Proven experience in successfully navigating and building partnerships across large, complex organizations.
  • Willingness to provide and receive direct, constructive feedback
  • Passion for working with students and HBCUs
  • Ability to prepare and maintain timely and accurate reports and correspondence.
  • Extensive experience in the use of computers and experience in word processing, spread sheets, database, and power point applications.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population. Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations and work collaboratively across functions, levels, and departments toward shared objectives.
  • Experience navigating policy requirements at an academic institution

Minimum Requirements

Advance degree (Master’s, JD, LLM, Ph.D or equivalent) and a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.

Compensation
